title: Dust Boxes and backgrounds
summary: Bigger Dust Boxes unlock as your score adds up over all runs; each box also unlocks a background.

rows.sub:
A tiny dust box.
The ghosts are packed like sardines inside.

A larger dust box.
Now the ghosts can finally escape their cramped house.

An even bigger dust box.
It's extra-large.
The ghosts' dream of a spacious home has finally come true.
Spend a thrilling BOOM-filled summer with her!
Perhaps an unexpected encounter awaits this summer?
